system.description: Advanced Move. When you go off on your own to explore a dangerous area, roll+DEX. On a 7 or higher you make it back safely; the GM will describe what you encountered.

success.label: Success!
success.value:
Choose two:
• Ask the GM one question as if you rolled a 7-9 to Examine the area you explored (you can choose this multiple times).
• Bring something interesting or useful back, the GM will say what.
• You made preparations while there, gain 1 Prep.

failure.label: Miss...
failure.value: Choose one from the list, in addition to whatever the GM says.
